content.short: We are building the world's first AI-based open-source learning infrastructure.
content.description: Customized, targeted learning is key for transforming an organization. The need for a new approach to workforce reskilling and upskilling is clear. LearnerShape is a leader in using AI and data science to accelerate enterprise learning. Flexible Learning We understand that no two organizations have the same learning needs. Our AI-based infrastructure can support any learning application you can imagine, using your skills framework and content of your choice (including from our extensive content library).
